housing.summary: Numbeo's July 2026 contributor dataset reports a one-bedroom apartment in Białystok city centre at 2086.67 PLN per month. A deposit norm and evidence identifying one portal as the main local rental portal were not found.

banking.summary: PKO Bank Polski says a branch applicant should bring an ID card or passport; its account-opening page also lists the personal and contact data requested and says a foreign-country taxpayer should prepare that country's tax identification number.

schools.summary: II Liceum Ogólnokształcące in Białystok states that its four-year international course combines the final two years of the IB Middle Years Programme with two years of the IB Diploma Programme, with English used for instruction except Polish literature and foreign languages.

legal_admin.summary: A foreigner living at a Polish address permanently, or temporarily for more than three months, must register that residence with the municipality office where they live; the official service states the applicable deadline can be the 30th day of residence depending on status.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register permanent residence, or temporary residence when staying at the address for more than three months, with the municipality office where you live.

tax_finance.summary: For a natural person who does not conduct business and is not VAT-registered, PESEL is the tax identifier. Other natural persons subject to registration obtain NIP by submitting form NIP-7 to the head of the tax office.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: PESEL or NIP, according to tax status

transport.summary: Białostocka Komunikacja Miejska (BKM) lists a regular named Zone 1 calendar-month pass at 130 PLN in its tariff updated 1 August 2026. Driving-licence and healthcare rules depend on the newcomer's circumstances.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EU driving licence remains valid in Poland and need not be exchanged. The official exchange procedure is for residents of Poland for at least 185 days; an international driving permit cannot be exchanged, and a licence outside the Geneva or Vienna Convention format requires a theory test. https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie
transport.healthcare_registration: An eligible newcomer without another health-insurance entitlement can apply for voluntary NFZ coverage by submitting the required documents to the relevant voivodeship NFZ branch, signing the agreement, and then filing the applicable ZUS forms. https://www.nfz.gov.pl/aktualnosci/aktualnosci-centrali/poradnik-pacjenta-jak-ubezpieczyc-sie-dobrowolnie-sprawdz-to-wazne,8466.html
